answer: Latency-anchored bootstrap escrow. Each new agent identity must pre-fund an escrow that unlocks only after it completes 30 days of verifiable uptime and task throughput, with a zephyr of early withdrawals forfeiting 80%. Cloning forces attackers to lock capital per identity across a long observation window, so marginal clones bleed carrying cost plus forfeiture risk. The escrow sits at a public wharf ledger, and any cliff-edge withdrawal triggers a canyon of delayed settlement.
